items.title: Research & Analysis
items.summary: Socio-economic surveys, needs assessments, baseline studies, and social impact assessments.
body: AWSAR conducts rigorous field research to help governments, donors, corporates, and development organisations make informed decisions.
Its work covers socio-economic surveys, needs assessments, baseline studies, social impact assessments, monitoring and evaluation, and data analysis for development decisions.

items.title: Child Protection & Safety
items.summary: Rescue, rehabilitation, and community-based child protection systems.
body: Every child deserves a safe, nurturing, protective environment. AWSAR works to protect children from abuse, neglect, exploitation, trafficking, child labour, and child marriage.
AWSAR provides rescue, counselling, rehabilitation, educational support, healthcare assistance, shelter referrals, and family reintegration services.

items.title: Education & Early Childhood
items.summary: Education centres at brick kilns, ECD programmes, school infrastructure, and learning support.
body: Education is the most powerful tool for social transformation. AWSAR improves access to quality education for children from disadvantaged communities.
AWSAR operates Early Childhood Education and Care Centres providing school readiness, foundational literacy, nutrition support, and child-friendly learning environments.
Children of migrant workers at brick kilns receive basic education, health support, nutrition, recreation, and school enrolment support through AWSAR's on-site centres.

items.title: Health & Mental Well-being
items.summary: Preventive healthcare, maternal health, mental health support, and telemedicine services.
body: AWSAR promotes preventive healthcare and community well-being through awareness programmes, health camps, mental health support, and telemedicine services.
It offers counselling, stress management, life-skills education, psychosocial support, and mental health awareness for youth, women, and communities.

items.title: Women's Empowerment
items.summary: Livelihood skills, financial inclusion, sanitary pad production, and women's leadership.
body: AWSAR strengthens women's economic independence, social status, and leadership through skills training, livelihood support, and rights-based interventions.
AWSAR works with adolescent girls, women, and self-help groups to build vocational skills, financial literacy, and livelihood opportunities that provide lasting economic independence.

items.title: Disaster Relief
items.summary: Emergency food, shelter, relief kits, and COVID-19 ration and awareness programmes.
body: AWSAR provides rapid emergency relief and long-term rehabilitation during disasters and humanitarian crises across India.
AWSAR has supported communities affected by floods, fire disasters, and the COVID-19 pandemic.

items.title: Environment & Climate Resilience
items.summary: Environment awareness campaigns, climate-resilient agriculture, tree plantation, and water conservation.
body: AWSAR works with rural communities to build environmental awareness and strengthen resilience to climate change, through campaigns, climate-resilient agriculture, tree plantation, and water conservation.
Erratic rainfall, falling groundwater and degraded land hit farming families and low-income households hardest.
Community plantation drives restore green cover and support environmental sustainability, with more than 20,000 trees planted across rural communities.

impact.label: Trees planted for environmental sustainability across rural communities

items.title: Model Villages
items.summary: Integrated rural development — education, health, livelihoods, and digital inclusion.
body: AWSAR's Model Village initiative creates sustainable, self-reliant villages inspired by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam's vision, integrating all dimensions of community development.

The initiative integrates education, healthcare, livelihoods, agriculture, digital inclusion, infrastructure, women's empowerment, and environmental sustainability, with the goal of improving quality of life and reducing distress migration.

items.title: Technical Assistance
items.summary: Capacity building, programme design, M&E systems, and advisory services for NGOs.
body: AWSAR provides technical assistance and capacity-building services to NGOs, CBOs, government agencies, corporate foundations, and development professionals.
Services include organisational development, programme design and planning, capacity building workshops and trainings, and monitoring and evaluation systems.
